Welcome to the `carecodeconnect` home page! 🤗

*"Building persuasive technologies with AI and Machine Learning for health, well-being & sustainability"*

We combine the tools of social science and data science to build solutions to complex social problems.

1. **Decode the matrix of human relations with technology**: by linking computation with interpretation, we tell the human stories behind the data.

2. **Build machine learning solutions to create caring futures**: a data revolution that is equitable, fair, and sustainable. Our solutions are infused with care, ethics, privacy. We are sensitive to cultural, geographical, historical circumstances, social contexts and differences that make a difference.

3. **Apply cutting-edge free and open source technologies to put people at the heart of the data**: creating evidence-based decision-making and actionable 'outsights' to make the world a better place.

In short, we **care**, **code**, **connect**.

Explore our [blog](blog.qmd) and [projects](projects.qmd) to find out more!

# Recent Work Experience

- **Lead Data Scientist, [Shoutt International](https://shoutt.ai), London (2026).** Production LLM and agentic systems for a two-sided freelance job marketplace: role classification for thousands of inconsistent job posts, a CV-review engine with a multi-model router, an agent pipeline that turns one API call into a branded interview-prep PDF, and the evaluation harnesses and metrics dashboards that showed whether any of it worked.

- **Founding Developer, [Life Repair Kit](https://www.liferepairkit.de), Berlin / remote (2026–present).** Sole developer of a German-language wellbeing platform: a single Rust/Axum binary serving a TypeScript SPA and PostgreSQL, the twelve-dimension *ResilienzRadar* self-assessment with on-device PDF results, a founder-editable resource hub and magazine, and the EU-only Scaleway infrastructure, CI/CD and security hardening behind it. [System design and architecture write-up](projects/life-repair-kit/index.html).

- **Data Scientist, [Lightfoot](https://www.lightfoot.co.uk/), Exeter (2024–2025).** Automated analytics, causal inference and predictive models for eco-driving behaviour change.

- **Data Scientist, [Data Science Retreat](https://datascienceretreat.com/), Berlin (2023–2024).** Led a team of four to build [Jhāna.AI](projects.qmd#jh%C4%81na.ai-personal-meditation-guide), an interactive meditation assistant guided by real-time voice and brain signals; prompt engineering and fine-tuning of open-source LLMs.

- **Data Scientist, Clinical Psychology, [Freie Universität Berlin](https://www.ewi-psy.fu-berlin.de/psychologie/arbeitsbereiche/klinische_psychotherapie/index.html) (2022–2023).** Led a research team building predictive models, data pipelines and interactive dashboards in Python and R, delivering insights to a stakeholder group of 60+ organisations.

- **Data Consultant, [Institute for Applied Sustainability Studies](https://www.rifs-potsdam.de/en/institute), Potsdam (2017–2021).** Social network analysis and an interactive data-visualisation dashboard of the sustainability field, for a project funded by the German Federal Ministry of Education and Research.

## Skills

- **Full-stack data science for production.** Research, model development, deployment, evaluation and monitoring across the lifecycle of a data product; software-engineering practice (testing, version control, CI/CD) applied to ML and AI pipelines at scale.

- **LLM and agentic systems that can be trusted.** Prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, multi-model routing, tool-using agents, RAG — and the part that makes them shippable: golden datasets, evaluation harnesses, regression tests, drift dashboards and cost/latency measurement. *Prompt for recall, deterministic code for precision.*

- **Hybrid pipelines.** Classical ML and rule-based NLP alongside generative models, each used where it wins on accuracy, cost or determinism.

- **Causal inference and experimentation.** Experimental and quasi-experimental design, A/B testing, forecasting, and twenty years of teaching research methods — quantitative, qualitative and mixed.

- **Persuasive technology for behaviour change** in health, well-being and sustainability, informed by human-computer interaction research.

- **Communication and leadership.** Translating technical work into decisions for non-technical stakeholders; mentoring; leading small cross-functional teams.
